blocks.raw: # Configure a Loyalty Promotion Event Notification
blocks.text: Configure a Loyalty Promotion Event Notification

blocks.raw: Event notifications allow you to stream near-real-time updates about your loyalty promotions to external systems via webhooks. You can get updates on when a new loyalty promotion is created and when a loyalty promotion is updated.
blocks.text: Event notifications allow you to stream near-real-time updates about your loyalty promotions to external systems via webhooks. You can get updates on when a new loyalty promotion is created and when a loyalty promotion is updated.

blocks.raw: For more information refer [Event Notifications Overview](https://docs.capillarytech.com/docs/overview) documentation.
blocks.text: For more information refer Event Notifications Overview documentation.

blocks.raw: The new loyalty promotions utilize the existing promotion event schemas. Currently, the system supports the following configuration events:
blocks.text: The new loyalty promotions utilize the existing promotion event schemas. Currently, the system supports the following configuration events:

blocks.raw:
| Event Name             | Trigger                                                                   | Documentation                                                                                                                             |
| :--------------------- | :------------------------------------------------------------------------ | :---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| **`promotionCreated`** | Fired whenever a new loyalty promotion is created via the UI or API.      | [View Schema](https://docs.capillarytech.com/docs/event-schema-loyalty-and-cart-promotions#creating-loyalty-promotion-promotioncreated)   |
| **`promotionUpdated`** | Fired whenever an existing loyalty promotion's configuration is modified. | [View Schema](https://docs.capillarytech.com/docs/event-schema-loyalty-and-cart-promotions#updating-a-loyalty-promotion-promotionupdated) |
